title: La pénalité d'apprentissage liée à l'IA générative au collège et au lycée

authors: David Strömberg, Victor Lei, Yanhui Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Les outils d’IA générative peuvent aider les élèves à réaliser leurs devoirs plus rapidement et à obtenir de meilleurs résultats. Mais l’objectif n’est pas simplement d’accomplir ces tâches ; il s’agit avant tout d’apprendre grâce à elles. Cet article s’appuie sur des données concernant plus de 25 000 élèves de la 5e à la terminale en Chine pour examiner comment l’utilisation autonome de l’IA générative influe sur leur apprentissage. Le temps consacré aux devoirs par les élèves ayant utilisé l’IA a diminué et leurs notes aux devoirs ont augmenté, mais leurs notes aux examens ont baissé. Si l’effet initial est faible, il s’amplifie à mesure que les élèves maîtrisent mieux les outils d’IA et que la quantité de matière étudiée augmente après leur adoption, ce qui suggère que les études existantes, de courte durée, pourraient sous-estimer les coûts d’apprentissage à long terme liés à l’utilisation de l’IA générative.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能工具可以帮助学生更快地完成作业并取得更好的成绩。但目标并非仅仅是完成这些任务，而首先是通过这些任务来学习。本文基于中国超过25 000名从五年级到高三学生的数据，考察自主使用生成式人工智能如何影响他们的学习。使用人工智能的学生完成作业的时间减少了，作业成绩提高了，但考试成绩下降了。如果初始效应较弱，那么随着学生更好地掌握人工智能工具以及采用后学习内容数量的增加，这一效应会放大，这表明现有的短期研究可能低估了与使用生成式人工智能相关的长期学习成本。

title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation

authors: Daniel R. Arnold, Michael R. Richards, Yashaswini Singh, Christopher M. Whaley
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.
abstract_zh: 技术创新扩散取决于激励、监管及企业战略行为。我们研究了在临床进步推动下，医疗保险扩大非医院设施治疗选择后，心脏手术市场中的这些交叉因素。州级监管限制了联邦促进竞争政策。在市场准入发生之处，业务抢夺集中于成本最低的治疗环境，而非高成本医院——导致医疗保险支出增加约250万美元。医疗保险政策还对未涉及的手术及其他支付方产生外部效应，除非医院与医生实现纵向整合。联邦规则制定与复杂市场动态相互作用，并受其缓和——包括可能以未预见的方式。

authors: Ricardo Alonso, Jed DeVaro, Antti Kauhanen, Nelli Valmari
official: 官方在线 2026-08-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document, using Finnish employer-employee matched panel data, that more productive firms are more likely to hire internally than externally. This result is interpreted via a new theoretical model in which the superior management practices of high-productivity firms enable their managers to screen internal candidates more accurately when recruiting across multiple applicant pools to fill a vacancy. More internal hiring usually results. The model’s further predictions are empirically supported, e.g., internal hiring rates increase in applicant pool size, education level of the internal pool, and managerial performance and education.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰雇主-雇员匹配面板数据记录到，生产率更高的企业更倾向于内部招聘而非外部招聘。这一结果通过一个新的理论模型进行解释，在该模型中，高生产率企业的卓越管理实践使其管理者在填补职位空缺时，能够更准确地筛选多个申请者池中的内部候选人。这通常导致更多的内部招聘。模型的进一步预测得到了实证支持，例如，内部招聘率随申请者池规模、内部池的教育水平以及管理绩效和教育程度的提高而上升。

title: Human capital and public-private wage differentials in the US: evidence from the NLSY79 (2008–2018)
title_zh: 美国人力资本与公私部门工资差异：来自NLSY79（2008—2018）的证据
title_primary: 美国人力资本与公私部门工资差异：来自NLSY79（2008—2018）的证据
title_secondary: Human capital and public-private wage differentials in the US: evidence from the NLSY79 (2008–2018)
authors: Kritkorn Nawakitphaitoon, Can Tang, Russell Ormiston
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite a long-standing literature documenting wage differentials between public and private sector workers in the US, the factors underlying these differences remain only partially understood. Existing studies examining human capital explanations for public-private wage differentials have largely focused on general labour market experience and firm tenure, with limited attention to industry and occupation-specific human capital. This study examines the extent to which different forms of human capital: general, firm-specific, industry-specific, and occupation-specific, which contribute to public-private wage differentials using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 (NLSY79) from 2008 to 2018. Employing Oaxaca decomposition, ordinary least squares, and random-effects models, the results show that human capital explains a substantial share of the observed public-sector wage premium. Firm-specific human capital is the largest contributor, followed by industry-specific human capital, while general human capital has a smaller but statistically significant effect. In contrast, occupation-specific human capital does not explain the wage differential once unobserved individual heterogeneity is taken into account. The findings are robust to propensity score matching and alternative sample restrictions. Overall, differences in the accumulation of specific human capital, particularly within firms and industries, help explain the persistence of public-private wage differentials in the US. abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献记录了美国公共部门与私营部门劳动者之间的工资差异，但造成这些差异的因素至今仍未得到充分理解。现有研究在考察人力资本对公私部门工资差异的解释时，主要聚焦于一般劳动力市场经验和企业任期，而对行业和职业特定人力资本的关注有限。本研究利用1979年全国青年纵向调查（NLSY79）2008年至2018年的数据，考察不同类型的人力资本——一般性、企业特定、行业特定和职业特定——在多大程度上解释了公私部门工资差异。通过采用Oaxaca分解、普通最小二乘法和随机效应模型，结果显示人力资本解释了所观察到的公共部门工资溢价中的相当大份额。企业特定人力资本是最大的贡献因素，其次是行业特定人力资本，而一般性人力资本的影响较小但具有统计显著性。相比之下，在考虑未观测到的个体异质性后，职业特定人力资本并不能解释工资差异。研究结果在倾向得分匹配和替代样本限制下依然稳健。总体而言，特定人力资本积累的差异，尤其是企业和行业层面的人力资本积累差异，有助于解释美国公私部门工资差异的持续存在。关键词：企业特定人力资本；行业特定人力资本；职业人力资本；部门工资差异 JEL分类：J24 J31 J45 J62 致谢 作者感谢在稿件准备过程中使用生成式人工智能和AI辅助技术以提升语言质量和可读性。

title: Real-Time Inequality and the Welfare State in Motion: Evidence from COVID-19 in Spain
title_zh: 实时不平等与运行中的福利国家：来自西班牙COVID-19的证据
title_primary: 实时不平等与运行中的福利国家：来自西班牙COVID-19的证据
title_secondary: Real-Time Inequality and the Welfare State in Motion: Evidence from COVID-19 in Spain
authors: Oriol Aspachs, Ruben Durante, Alberto Graziano, Josep Mestres, Jose G Montalvo 等
official: 官方在线 2022-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: SUMMARY G. Montalvo and Marta Reynal-Querol?>Official statistics on economic inequality are only available at low frequency and with considerable delay. This makes it challenging to assess the impact on inequality of fast-unfolding crises like the COVID-19 pandemic, and to rapidly evaluate and tailor policy responses. We propose a new methodology to track income inequality at high frequency using anonymized data from bank records for over three million account holders in Spain. Using this approach, we analyse how inequality evolved between February and November 2020 (compared to the same months of 2019). We first show that the wage distribution in our data matches very closely that from official labour surveys. We then document that, in the absence of government intervention, inequality would have increased dramatically, mainly due to job losses and wage cuts experienced by low-wage workers. The increase in pre-transfer inequality was especially pronounced among the young and the foreign-born, and in regions more dependent on services. Public transfers and unemployment insurance schemes were effective at providing a safety net to the most affected segments of the population and at offsetting most of the increase in inequality. Increased inequality is primarily driven by differential changes in employment rate. Indeed, using individual-level regressions, we find that, over the course of the pandemic, the probability of being employed decreased drastically for workers in the lower part of the pre-COVID wage distribution, young cohorts and foreign-born.
abstract_zh: G. Montalvo和Marta Reynal-Querol的摘要： 官方关于经济不平等性的统计数据仅以较低频率获取，且存在显著延迟。这使得评估像COVID-19疫情这样快速演变的危机对不平等性的影响，以及迅速评估和调整政策应对措施变得具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新方法，利用西班牙超过三百万账户持有人的银行记录匿名数据，以高频率追踪收入不平等性。采用这一方法，我们分析了2020年2月至11月期间（与2019年同期相比）不平等性的演变情况。我们首先表明，我们数据中的工资分布与官方劳动力调查结果高度吻合。随后，我们记录到，在缺乏政府干预的情况下，不平等性将急剧上升，主要原因是低工资工人遭受的失业和工资削减。转移前不平等性的增加在年轻人、外国出生者以及更依赖服务业的地区尤为显著。公共转移支付和失业保险计划在为主要受影响群体提供安全网以及抵消大部分不平等性增加方面发挥了有效作用。不平等性的加剧主要由就业率的差异性变化驱动。实际上，利用个体层面回归分析，我们发现，在疫情期间，对于疫情前工资分布较低端的工人、年轻群体和外国出生者，就业概率大幅下降。

title: Contagion-Based Safety Premium in Bank Networks
title_zh: 银行网络中的传染性安全溢价
title_primary: 银行网络中的传染性安全溢价
title_secondary: Contagion-Based Safety Premium in Bank Networks
authors: Zhongjie Fan, Ping He, Zehao Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine safety premiums through the lens of financial contagion in interbank networks. In our model with endogenous collateralized lending contracts, safe assets command premiums because they relax funding constraints without amplifying default propagation. Multiple equilibria characterized by distinct lending volumes and safety premiums emerge exclusively in networks containing directed cycles. The safety premium thus serves as a tractable, price-based statistic of systemic fragility. Comparative statics show that conditions weakening contagion—most notably a sufficiently high safe-to-risky-asset ratio—can eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. Pure-strategy high-lending equilibria survive only when collateral quality is sufficiently high. Network structure critically influences these dynamics: increased density introduces competing effects (amplified contagion risk versus enhanced liquidity coinsurance), with their relative dominance determined by loan sizes and collateral quality. Core-periphery networks generate higher safety premiums than complete networks, as peripheral banks respond defensively to the amplified contagion risk circulating within the core. A greater number or larger size of peripheral banks leads to a higher safety premium.
abstract_zh: 我们从银行间网络中的金融传染视角考察安全溢价。在我们的内生抵押贷款合约模型中，安全资产之所以享有溢价，是因为它们在不加剧违约传播的情况下缓解了融资约束。以不同贷款规模和安全溢价为特征的多个均衡，仅在包含有向环的网络中出现。因此，安全溢价可作为衡量系统性脆弱性的一个易于处理的、基于价格的统计指标。比较静态分析表明，削弱传染的条件——尤其是足够高的安全资产与风险资产比率——能够消除均衡的多重性。纯策略高贷款均衡仅在抵押品质量足够高时才能存续。网络结构对这些动态具有关键影响：密度增加引入了竞争效应（传染风险放大与流动性共同保险增强），其相对主导地位取决于贷款规模和抵押品质量。核心-外围网络产生的安全溢价高于完全网络，因为外围银行对核心内部循环放大的传染风险采取防御性反应。外围银行数量更多或规模更大，会导致更高的安全溢价。

title: Climate shocks, attitudes towards intimate partner violence, and the protective role of climate-resilience projects

title_primary: 气候冲击、对亲密伴侣暴力的态度及气候韧性项目的保护作用

authors: Amanda Guimbeau, Xinde James Ji, Nidhiya Menon
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the impact of climate change on intimate partner violence attitudes in Bangladesh and shows that policy can mitigate much, if not all, of the harmful consequences of climate shocks on women. Utilizing a novel dataset linking geo-referenced meteorological data with information on women’s attitudes, we find that dry shocks increase tolerance for intimate partner violence among women in poor and agriculture-dependent communities, with suggestive evidence that this happens due to the erosion of women’s outside options. Distributed-lag estimates show that these effects persist beyond the immediate period of exposure, consistent with a gradual weakening of women’s fallback positions rather than a purely short-run stress-induced or backlash response. Climate resilience projects funded by the Bangladesh Climate Change Trust (BCCT), a domestic climate fund, mitigate the negative impacts of dry shocks, highlighting the significant role of such initiatives in generating positive ameliorative spillover effects. Remotely sensed data on land use and crop-yield indicators reveal that these projects protect agriculture during dry shocks, especially in the rainfed Aman season, thus providing a credible test of the importance of the agricultural transmission channel and the pathway through which such projects buffer climate shocks. Our findings underline the crucial role of targeted policies in fostering climate adaptation. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了气候变化对孟加拉国亲密伴侣暴力态度的影响，并表明政策能够在很大程度上，甚至完全缓解气候冲击对女性造成的有害后果。通过利用将地理参考气象数据与女性态度信息相结合的新数据集，我们发现干旱冲击增加了贫困及农业依赖社区中女性对亲密伴侣暴力的容忍度，且有提示性证据表明，这一现象源于女性外部选择的削弱。分布滞后估计显示，这些影响在暴露期之后持续存在，与女性后备地位的逐渐弱化相一致，而非纯粹短期压力诱发或反弹反应。由孟加拉国气候变化信托基金（BCCT）这一国内气候基金资助的气候韧性项目缓解了干旱冲击的负面影响，凸显了此类倡议在产生积极改善性溢出效应方面的重要作用。基于遥感数据的土地利用和作物产量指标揭示，这些项目在干旱冲击期间保护了农业，尤其是在依赖雨养的阿曼季节，从而为农业传导渠道的重要性及此类项目缓冲气候冲击的路径提供了可信的检验。我们的研究结果强调了针对性政策在促进气候适应中的关键作用。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accurately reconstructing historical cropland distribution is essential for quantifying the environmental impacts of agricultural land-use change and understanding human–environment interactions. Existing statistical inference methods provide long temporal coverage but suffer from limited spatial accuracy, while remote sensing–based approaches offer high spatial resolution but are constrained in historical depth and often exhibit area biases. To overcome these limitations, this study developed an integrated reconstruction framework and produced a yearly cropland spatial distribution dataset for China from 1850 to 2020 at a 5 km resolution. Multi-source data, including historical archives, statistical yearbooks, and national land surveys, were synthesized to construct a temporally continuous and internally consistent provincial cropland area time series through phased identification, correction, and interpolation. A dynamically weighted joint probability index was then established by combining remote sensing–derived spatial probabilities with physical suitability–based potential probabilities, enabling consistent spatial allocation of cropland before and after the remote sensing era. Results indicate that China’s cropland area experienced a “fluctuating increase–rapid expansion–continuous decline” trajectory, peaking around 1980. Cropland distribution shifted northward toward Northeast China since the early 20th century and toward Northwest China after the 1950s, while several southern and eastern provinces exhibited net cropland loss by 2020. Compared with existing datasets, the reconstructed product shows higher consistency with national land surveys and more accurately captures key spatial evolution processes. This dataset provides robust support for long-term cropland change assessment and environmental impact studies in China.
abstract_zh: 精确重建历史耕地分布对于量化农业土地利用变化的环境影响以及理解人类-环境相互作用至关重要。现有统计推断方法虽能覆盖较长时间跨度，但空间精度有限；而基于遥感的方法虽具有高空间分辨率，却在历史深度上受限且常存在面积偏差。为克服这些局限，本研究构建了一个集成重建框架，并生成了中国1850—2020年逐年、5公里分辨率的耕地空间分布数据集。通过整合历史档案、统计年鉴和全国土地调查等多源数据，采用分阶段识别、校正与插值方法，构建了时间连续且内部一致的省级耕地面积时间序列。进一步结合遥感衍生的空间概率与基于物理适宜性的潜在概率，建立了动态加权联合概率指数，实现了遥感时代前后耕地的空间一致性分配。结果表明，中国耕地面积经历了“波动增长—快速扩张—持续减少”的轨迹，约在1980年达到峰值。自20世纪初以来，耕地分布向东北地区北移，1950年代后向西北地区扩展，而多个南方和东部省份在2020年出现耕地净减少。与现有数据集相比，重建产品与全国土地调查的一致性更高，并能更准确地捕捉关键空间演变过程。该数据集为中国长期耕地变化评估及环境影响研究提供了有力支撑。

authors: Taisuke Imai, Davide D. Pace, Peter Schwardmann, Joël J. van der Weele
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。

authors: Oecd

abstract: Recruitment difficulties, changing career patterns and growing classroom diversity have prompted many OECD education systems to look beyond traditional initial teacher education to recruit experienced professionals from other fields. This working paper synthesises what is known about these second-career teachers (SCTs). It is structured around six questions: who they are, where they work, how they are prepared and supported, how they integrate into schools, what they contribute, and how they can be retained. Drawing on the international research literature, recent OECD data – including original analysis using a broader definition of SCT than the published TALIS measure – and policy examples from OECD systems, the paper identifies key aspects to support effective preparation, sets out the conditions that shape SCTs
abstract_zh: 招聘困难、职业模式变迁及课堂多样性日益增强，促使众多OECD教育体系超越传统职前教师教育范畴，从其他领域招募经验丰富的专业人士。本工作论文综合梳理了关于这些第二职业教师（SCTs）的现有认知，围绕六个核心问题展开：他们是谁、在何处任职、如何接受培养与支持、如何融入学校、贡献何在以及如何留任。通过借鉴国际研究文献、近期OECD数据（包括采用比已发布的TALIS指标更宽泛的SCT定义进行的原创分析）及OECD体系内的政策案例，本文识别出支持有效培养的关键要素，并阐述了塑造SCTs职业发展的条件。

title: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation

authors: Kaustav Das, Tatiana Mayskaya, Arina Nikandrova
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes. (JEL D21, D83, G34, O31)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在创新可行性不确定的动态模型中，并购对研发活动的影响。并购具有三种效应：可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应）、提高首个颠覆性创新的概率（占有效应），以及使该创新提前实现（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，并购更可取；而当创新路径较为清晰时，并购的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是：若首次创新与后续创新之间的替代性越强，并购的收益可能越高。（JEL D21, D83, G34, O31）

abstract: Using itinerary-level global air traffic data, this paper proposes a novel instrumental variable to estimate the effect of in-person interactions on bilateral trade. By exploiting exogenous variations in air connectivity that are driven by third-country connecting capacities, we show that increased air connections boost trade, especially for complex industries and new products. Online interactions appear to be a limited substitute for in-person contact. These findings confirm the role of in-person communications in reducing information-sharing barriers. Our estimation approach also provides a useful tool for evaluating the social and economic impacts of a complex transport network.
abstract_zh: 本文利用航线层面的全球航空交通数据，提出了一种新颖的工具变量，用以估计面对面交流对双边贸易的影响。通过利用由第三国中转能力驱动的航空连通性外生变化，我们发现航空联系的增加促进了贸易增长，尤其是在复杂行业和新产品领域。在线互动似乎难以有效替代面对面接触。这些发现证实了面对面交流在降低信息共享障碍方面的作用。我们的估计方法也为评估复杂交通网络的社会经济影响提供了有效工具。

title: Designing Incentives for Impatient People: An RCT Promoting Exercise to Manage Diabetes

authors: Aggarwal, Shilpa, Dizon-Ross, Rebecca, Zucker, Ariel
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many people are impatient. We introduce domain-specific discounting to a contracting model and test a prediction for how to make incentives work well when people are im- patient over effort: implement time-bundled contracts that make the payment for future effort increase in current effort. Using a randomized evaluation of an exercise incentive program among diabetics in India, we find that time-bundled contracts generate equiv- alent e ort to time-separable contracts at 15% lower cost. Moreover, they perform 30% better among individuals with above-median effort impatience. Pooled across contracts, incentives increase steps by 20% and improve blood sugar relative to a control group.
abstract_zh: 许多人缺乏耐心。我们将领域特定贴现引入契约模型，并检验一项关于如何在人们对努力缺乏耐心时有效设计激励措施的预测：实施时间捆绑契约，使未来努力的报酬随当前努力增加而递增。通过对印度糖尿病患者运动激励项目的随机评估，我们发现时间捆绑契约能以比时间可分离契约低15%的成本产生同等努力水平。此外，在努力耐心程度高于中位数的个体中，其效果提升30%。综合各类契约来看，与对照组相比，激励措施使步数增加20%，并改善血糖水平。

official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Hundreds of thousands of children grow up in the US foster care system every year and are at high risk of experiencing negative outcomes such as incarceration and homelessness. This paper documents how the placement of foster children into families rather than congregate care improves their outcomes using the exits of other children from families as an instrument for their placement setting. Policies that change which children are matched to families can achieve a large percentage of the gains from policies that add families to the foster care system due to heterogeneity in treatment effects.

title: The Impact of the US‐China Trade War on Vietnam's US Exports
title_zh: 中美贸易战对越南对美出口的影响
title_primary: 中美贸易战对越南对美出口的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of the US‐China Trade War on Vietnam's US Exports
authors: Joonhyung Lee, Kang Keun Rhee
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the unintended consequences of the 2018–2019 US‐China trade war for Vietnam, a key bystander economy, using quarterly HS 8‐digit US import data from 2017Q1 to 2020Q4. While the average treatment effect on Vietnam's exports to the US is small and statistically insignificant, substantial heterogeneity arises from pre‐war revealed comparative advantages (RCAs). Vietnam experienced markedly stronger export growth in sectors where China held high pre‐war RCA, consistent with trade diversion and substitution effects. These gains were nonlinear and most pronounced in sectors where Vietnam initially had low comparative advantage, reflecting the exploitation of previously untapped export opportunities. Consequently, Vietnam captured meaningful trade‐diversion benefits primarily outside its pre‐existing areas of comparative strength. In addition, we provide consistent evidence that the relocation of MNCs is strongly associated with the observed export surge. By quantifying these spillovers, our study contributes to the literature on global value chain dynamics and trade protectionism.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2017年第一季度至2020年第四季度美国HS 8位数进口季度数据，考察了2018-2019年中美贸易战对关键旁观经济体越南的意外后果。尽管越南对美出口的平均处理效应较小且统计上不显著，但战前显性比较优势（RCA）的差异导致了显著的异质性。在中国战前RCA较高的行业中，越南出口增长明显更为强劲，这与贸易转移和替代效应一致。这些收益呈非线性特征，且在越南初始比较优势较低的行业中最为显著，反映了对先前未开发出口机会的利用。因此，越南主要在其既有比较优势领域之外获得了显著的贸易转移收益。此外，我们提供了一致证据表明，跨国公司的迁移与观察到的出口激增密切相关。通过量化这些溢出效应，本研究为全球价值链动态与贸易保护主义相关文献做出了贡献。

title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等
title_primary: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等
title_secondary: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
authors: Oren Danieli
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业中的工人分散于整个工资分布下半部分，但为何中位数工资却出现下降；2）为何在技术变革持续进行的情况下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业中技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，我验证了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违反了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入了一种“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。

title: 新发展格局下的全国统一大市场建设——基于省际间货运往来的测度

authors: 解咪, 钟宁桦, 姬永顺, 闫晟煜
official: 官方发布 2026-05-20 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 为加快构建新发展格局，亟须纵深推进全国统一大市场建设，增强省际贸易往来。本文基于2011—2023年全国高速公路货运数据，尤其是2021—2023年约60亿辆次车流信息，构建月度省际货运交流数据及运量、运距加权的跨省货运供需指数，以量化各省份在商品流通层面参与全国统一大市场建设的程度。研究发现：（1）超七成货运量发生在相邻省份间，河北、江苏、广东和四川为各自区域的关键枢纽；仅考虑货运量，中部地区跨省货运占比最高。综合考虑运量与运距后，东部地区指数更高，在长距离商品流通中发挥强辐射作用。（2）经济总量越大、二产占比越高、进出口总额越高的省份通常跨省货运指数越高。（3）结合季度GDP与约3.76亿条招聘数据的实证分析表明，运距加权的跨省货运供需指数与未来1—2个季度经济增长及1—7个月的招聘需求扩张显著正相关，且效应主要来自存量企业的扩产扩招。本文研究揭示了省际货运网络的空间格局与结构特征，表明长距离跨省货运是全国统一大市场建设在商品流通环节的重要表征，并揭示了全国统一大市场建设对稳增长与就业具有重要作用。本文构建的高频指数为动态监测全国统一大市场运行、评估区域协同成效与优化宏观调控提供新的量化工具。

title: Shrinkflation, unit price disclosure, and consumer welfare: Evidence from canned tuna
title_zh: 缩水式通胀、单价披露与消费者福利：来自金枪鱼罐头的证据
title_primary: 缩水式通胀、单价披露与消费者福利：来自金枪鱼罐头的证据
title_secondary: Shrinkflation, unit price disclosure, and consumer welfare: Evidence from canned tuna
authors: Xibo Wan, Katherine Harris-Lagoudakis, John M. Crespi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Shrinkflation, the downsizing of packages without proportional price cuts, raises effective prices in ways that are often difficult for consumers to detect under bounded attention. We exploit a documented episode of product downsizing, combined with preexisting state-level variation in unit price disclosure rules, to identify how information design affects consumer behavior and welfare. Using a matched sample of scanner data and a control function approach, we show that consumers in regulated states are three times more responsive to unit price changes, consistent with disclosure increasing the salience of the relevant price metric. Counterfactual simulations indicate that nationwide disclosure would raise annual consumer surplus by $3.03 million in the short term and $8.33 million in the long term once retailers adjust prices strategically. At present, only 16 states regulate unit price labeling on food items. Our findings demonstrate that such labeling improves consumer decision-making under shrinkflation.
abstract_zh: 缩水式通胀，即包装尺寸缩减而价格未按比例下调，会在有限注意力条件下以消费者往往难以察觉的方式提高实际价格。我们利用一次有记录的產品缩水事件，结合各州在单位价格披露规则上已有的差异，来识别信息设计如何影响消费者行为与福利。通过匹配的扫描数据样本和控制函数方法，我们表明，在受监管的州，消费者对单位价格变化的反应程度是其他州的三倍，这与披露增强了相关价格指标的显著性相一致。反事实模拟显示，若在全国范围内实施披露，短期内消费者剩余将增加303万美元，长期内，在零售商策略性调整价格后，将增加833万美元。目前，仅有16个州对食品的单位价格标签进行监管。我们的研究结果表明，此类标签在缩水式通胀情境下能改善消费者的决策质量。

title: Counteracting the Impact of Societal Aging on Income Inequality : A Case Study of Malaysia
title_zh: 应对社会老龄化对收入不平等的影响：马来西亚案例研究
title_primary: 应对社会老龄化对收入不平等的影响：马来西亚案例研究
title_secondary: Counteracting the Impact of Societal Aging on Income Inequality : A Case Study of Malaysia
authors: World Bank
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of societal aging on income inequality in Malaysia, to date and in the coming decades. The study starts from the hypothesis that, all things equal, aging exerts upward pressure on inequality (Deaton and Paxson (1994, 1995)). Drawing on nationally representative household survey data over the past two decades, the study finds evidence in support of this hypothesis in Malaysia. This picture becomes even sharper when projecting inequality levels for the years when Malaysia is forecast to reach aged (2045) and super-aged (2056) status. Estimates show that between 2022 and 2056, overall inequality of individual incomes could rise by as much as 13 percent due to aging. The analysis then demonstrates that expansion of a social pension system would attenuate this projected rise in inequality. The paper also undertakes counterfactual exercises simulating the expansion of an old age social pension with various design variants. The variants considered would expand existing social transfers for older people. Given the public revenue and spending patterns in Malaysia, some of these design options are potentially manageable from a fiscal perspective. The analysis suggests that, relative to the observed situation in 2022, wider coverage of social pensions could have resulted in lower inequality in household per capita income among older individuals (by 12–26 percent), thereby lowering overall inequality (by 4-9 percent). This inequality-reducing effect of social pensions becomes even more marked when projecting estimates of inequality for 2045 and 2056. Moreover, the findings show that expanded pensions would have resulted in a lower headcount poverty rate in 2022 by 1.3–4.2 percentage points among the 60+ population, and by 0.5–1.9 points among the overall population.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了马来西亚当前及未来数十年人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。研究基于"在其他条件不变的情况下，老龄化会加剧不平等压力"这一假设（Deaton & Paxson, 1994, 1995）。通过利用过去二十年间具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，本研究发现马来西亚的数据支持该假设。当预测马来西亚达到"老龄化社会"（2045年）和"超老龄化社会"（2056年）年份的不平等水平时，这一趋势更为显著。估算显示，2022年至2056年间，仅因老龄化因素，个人收入总体不平等程度可能上升高达13%。进一步分析表明，扩大社会养老金体系将缓解这一预期中的不平等加剧趋势。本文还开展了反事实模拟，考察不同设计方案的老年社会养老金扩面效果。所考虑的方案将扩大现有针对老年人的社会转移支付。基于马来西亚公共收入与支出模式，部分设计方案在财政层面具有潜在可行性。分析表明，相较于2022年观测到的实际情况，扩大社会养老金覆盖率可使老年人家庭人均收入不平等程度降低12%-26%，进而使总体不平等程度下降4%-9%。当对2045年和2056年的不平等水平进行预测时，社会养老金的这种不平等缓解效应更为显著。此外，研究结果显示，扩大养老金覆盖可使2022年60岁以上人口贫困发生率降低1.3-4.2个百分点，总人口贫困发生率降低0.5-1.9个百分点。

title: How U.S. Bank Stock Prices Respond to Geopolitical Risk
title_zh: 美国银行股价格如何应对地缘政治风险
title_primary: 美国银行股价格如何应对地缘政治风险
title_secondary: How U.S. Bank Stock Prices Respond to Geopolitical Risk
authors: Friederike Niepmann, Leslie Sheng Shen, Joshua Walker
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
abstract_zh: 地缘政治风险已成为全球金融市场的核心驱动因素，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰及近期中东冲突等事件引发了资产价格的剧烈波动和市场波动性的上升。本文简要探讨了地缘政治风险如何影响美国银行估值，以及哪些机构最为脆弱。通过跨境贷款、海外子公司和交易活动，银行面临多方面的地缘政治风险敞口，这些风险可能通过信贷损失、融资市场中断和手续费收入变化影响其盈利能力。银行的估值进而影响其融资成本和资本筹集能力，最终影响对实体经济的信贷供给。若地缘政治风险对不同银行的影响存在差异，则可能在金融体系内造成不均衡的脆弱性，这对金融稳定具有重要影响。

title: Supply chain risk perception, FinTech, and cross-regional capital flows: evidence from China
title_zh: 供应链风险感知、金融科技与跨区域资本流动：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 供应链风险感知、金融科技与跨区域资本流动：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Supply chain risk perception, FinTech, and cross-regional capital flows: evidence from China
authors: Zinan Wu, Wen Li, Xuesong Tang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2022, this paper examines how supply chain risk perception affects cross-regional investment. We find that such perception significantly reduces cross-regional investment, while regional FinTech development mitigates this effect. Mechanism tests identify three channels: increased cash holdings, weakened risk-taking willingness, and strategic contraction. The inhibitory effect is more pronounced in firms within highly competitive industries, regions with lower internet development, and firms with severe managerial myopia. Our findings illuminate the spatial spillover effects of supply chain risk and offer evidence for optimizing cross-regional investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2007年至2022年中国A股上市公司数据，考察供应链风险感知对跨区域投资的影响。研究发现，供应链风险感知显著减少了企业的跨区域投资，而区域金融科技的发展则缓解了这一效应。机制检验识别出三条路径：现金持有增加、风险承担意愿减弱及战略收缩。抑制作用在竞争激烈行业中的企业、互联网发展水平较低地区以及管理层短视严重的企业中更为显著。本研究揭示了供应链风险的空间溢出效应，并为优化跨区域投资决策提供了证据支持。

title: Murder in the Marketplace
title_zh: 市场中的谋杀
title_primary: 市场中的谋杀
title_secondary: Murder in the Marketplace
authors: Victoria Biagi, Alexander Cardazzi, Zachary Porreca
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Violence is often viewed as an intrinsic feature of illicit markets, driven by competition, disputes, and predation. We argue that the connection between violence and markets is not exclusive to illicit markets and that in the absence of strong institutions these factors exist ubiquitously. Using an estimator of spatial concentration, we document the empirical relationship between violence and markets in the Fourteenth Century. We then employ a large language model to analyze the coroner’s accounts of the era’s homicides, finding that many of these incidents were driven by avoidable escalations of business-related disputes. Employing a difference-in-differences estimator for spatial concentration, we proceed to causally identify the impacts of the introduction of London’s first professional police force in the nineteenth century on this concentration. We find that the police force’s introduction led to a 54% reduction in the degree of concentration of violence around marketplaces. Our findings suggest that it is not the nature of the commodities being sold in illicit markets that drives violence, but is rather the absence of formal institutions of enforcement and dispute resolution.
abstract_zh: 暴力常被视为非法市场的固有特征，源于竞争、纠纷与掠夺。我们认为，暴力与市场之间的联系并非仅限于非法市场，在缺乏强有力制度的情况下，这些因素普遍存在。利用空间集中度估计方法，我们记录了十四世纪暴力与市场之间的实证关系。随后，我们运用大型语言模型分析该时代验尸官记录中的凶杀案，发现许多此类事件源于商业纠纷的可避免升级。采用双重差分估计器分析空间集中度，我们进一步因果识别了十九世纪伦敦首支职业警察部队的引入对这一集中度的影响。我们发现，警察部队的引入导致市场周边暴力集中度下降了54%。我们的研究结果表明，驱动暴力的并非非法市场所售商品的性质，而是缺乏正式的执法与纠纷解决制度。

title: Firm‐level responses to export demand shocks: Swedish and Finnish exporters
title_zh: 企业层面应对出口需求冲击：瑞典与芬兰出口商
title_primary: 企业层面应对出口需求冲击：瑞典与芬兰出口商
title_secondary: Firm‐level responses to export demand shocks: Swedish and Finnish exporters
authors: Terhi Maczulskij, Zouheir El‐Sahli, Katariina Nilsson Hakkala
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how incumbent exporters adjust to firm-specific export demand shocks, using matched firm-, product- and destination-level data for Finnish and Swedish manufacturing firms over 1999–2014. We construct an exogenous measure of firm-level demand shocks based on changes in destination–product imports, and analyse responses at both the intensive and extensive margins of trade. Despite similar levels of openness and export structure, exporters in the two countries exhibit distinct adjustment patterns. Swedish firms respond strongly to positive demand shocks by expanding exports while simultaneously narrowing their export portfolio, reallocating sales towards core markets and products. Finnish firms, in contrast, show limited export expansion and adjust less along the product margin, instead reallocating sales towards domestic markets during downturns. We find limited evidence that firms' financial strength explains these differences. The results highlight the central role of firm-level extensive-margin adjustments in shaping aggregate export dynamics, and provide a micro-level explanation for the diverging post global financial crisis export trajectories of Finland and Sweden.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1999年至2014年间芬兰和瑞典制造业企业的匹配企业、产品及目的地层面数据，研究在位出口商如何应对企业特定出口需求冲击。我们基于目的地-产品进口变化构建了一个外生的企业层面需求冲击度量，并从贸易的集约边际和扩展边际两方面分析其反应。尽管两国的开放程度和出口结构相似，但两国出口商展现出截然不同的调整模式。瑞典企业通过扩大出口对正向需求冲击作出强烈反应，同时收窄其出口组合，将销售重新配置至核心市场和产品。相比之下，芬兰企业在正向冲击下出口扩张有限，在产品边际上的调整较少，反而在衰退期间将销售转向国内市场。我们发现企业财务实力对这些差异的解释作用有限。研究结果凸显了企业层面扩展边际调整在塑造总体出口动态中的核心作用，并为芬兰和瑞典在全球金融危机后出口轨迹的分化提供了微观层面的解释。

title: The socioeconomic impacts of industrial parks in Ethiopia
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚工业园区社会经济影响研究
title_primary: 埃塞俄比亚工业园区社会经济影响研究
title_secondary: The socioeconomic impacts of industrial parks in Ethiopia
authors: Guangbo Huang, Min Wang, Huayu Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the impacts of industrial parks on economic growth, living standards, and women’s empowerment in Ethiopia. Exploiting the staggered openings of parks across districts and combining satellite imagery with detailed survey data, we document several key findings. First, the establishment of an industrial park leads to sizable gains in local economic activity and urbanization. However, these effects remain spatially concentrated, with little evidence of spillovers into nearby districts. Second, parks situated in areas with stronger market access, larger labor pools, and better transport connectivity generate substantially larger impacts, underscoring the importance of location fundamentals. Third, the arrival of a park improves local living standards and raises employment rates — particularly among women — reflecting the parks’ predominant focus on female-labor-intensive industries. This shift enhances women’s decision-making power and reduces their acceptance of domestic violence, suggesting meaningful progress toward female empowerment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了工业园区对埃塞俄比亚经济增长、生活水平及女性赋权的影响。利用各区工业园区分阶段设立的情况，结合卫星影像与详细调查数据，我们记录了若干关键发现。首先，工业园区的建立显著促进了当地经济活动与城市化进程。然而，这些效应在空间上高度集中，几乎没有证据表明存在向邻近地区的溢出效应。其次，位于市场准入更佳、劳动力规模更大及交通连接更优区域的工业园区，其影响显著更大，凸显了区位基础条件的重要性。第三，工业园区的到来改善了当地生活水平并提高了就业率——尤其是女性就业率——这反映了园区主要集中于女性劳动密集型产业的特点。这一转变增强了女性的决策权，并减少了她们对家庭暴力的接受度，表明在女性赋权方面取得了实质性进展。

title: Occupational affiliation and the incidence of environmental regulation
title_zh: 职业归属与环境规制的发生率
title_primary: 职业归属与环境规制的发生率
title_secondary: Occupational affiliation and the incidence of environmental regulation
authors: Alex L. Marten, Andrew Schreiber, Ann Wolverton
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Empirical research suggests that occupational heterogeneity is crucial to explaining labor market outcomes. However, most computable general equilibrium models used to assess energy and environmental policies assume a single labor type that can easily shift from one occupation to another. We evaluate the social cost and incidence implications of labor market heterogeneity via limits it imposes on labor mobility and substitution in the supply and demand of occupations within a computable general equilibrium model. We find that occupational heterogeneity has limited implications for aggregate social costs but plays a key role in how those costs are distributed across households.
abstract_zh: 实证研究表明，职业异质性对于解释劳动力市场结果至关重要。然而，用于评估能源与环境政策的大多数可计算一般均衡模型假设单一劳动类型，能够轻易在不同职业间转换。我们通过在一个可计算一般均衡模型中，对劳动力流动性及职业供需替代性施加限制，评估了劳动力市场异质性对社会成本及其分布的影响。我们发现，职业异质性对总体社会成本的影响有限，但在这些成本如何在不同家庭间分配方面扮演关键角色。

title: Information alliance in common agency
title_zh: 共同代理中的信息联盟
title_primary: 共同代理中的信息联盟
title_secondary: Information alliance in common agency
authors: Rafael Costa Lima, Humberto Moreira, Alexander Rodivilov, Dongsoo Shin
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study an agency model with two independent projects each of which is owned by a principal. Under exclusive agency, each principal uses a different agent, whereas under common agency, all principals use the same agent. A project’s outcome depends on the agent’s hidden effort. We show that, even in the absence of physical linkages between the projects, a principal benefits from providing information on her project outcome to the other principal under common agency (rather than benefiting from receiving the information ), whereas no such benefits arise under exclusive agency. That is, under common agency, an information sharing principal can take advantage of the other principal’s using the shared information. As a result, sharing information becomes each principal’s dominant strategy, provided that the other principal uses the shared information in a Pareto-optimal way. We show that using a common agent is optimal when information can be shared.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个独立项目的委托代理模型，每个项目由一位委托人所有。在独家代理模式下，每位委托人雇佣不同的代理人；而在共同代理模式下，所有委托人雇佣同一代理人。项目的产出取决于代理人的隐性努力。研究表明，即使项目之间不存在物理关联，在共同代理模式下，委托人通过向另一位委托人提供自身项目结果的信息（而非接收信息）能够获益，而这种收益在独家代理模式下并不存在。也就是说，在共同代理模式下，共享信息的委托人可以利用另一位委托人对共享信息的使用。因此，只要另一位委托人以帕累托最优方式使用共享信息，信息共享将成为每位委托人的占优策略。我们证明，当信息可以共享时，使用共同代理人是最优选择。

title: Repurposing Agricultural Budgets With Multiple Objectives and Fiscal Constraints: A Multicriteria Decision‐Making Policy Tool Applied to Sub‐Saharan African Countries
title_zh: 多重目标与财政约束下的农业预算重新配置：应用于撒哈拉以南非洲国家的多准则决策政策工具
title_primary: 多重目标与财政约束下的农业预算重新配置：应用于撒哈拉以南非洲国家的多准则决策政策工具
title_secondary: Repurposing Agricultural Budgets With Multiple Objectives and Fiscal Constraints: A Multicriteria Decision‐Making Policy Tool Applied to Sub‐Saharan African Countries
authors: Marco V. Sánchez, Martín Cicowiez, Lucia Battaglia, Valentina Pernechele
official: 官方在线 2026-05-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Repurposing agricultural public resources toward higher‐return incentives and investments can help transform agri‐food systems. This is important for low‐income countries, especially in sub‐Saharan Africa, where limited budgets restrict options for boosting agricultural spending. We demonstrate how, within a tight budget envelope, opportunities exist to achieve better agricultural transformation outcomes. To this end, we developed the policy optimization modelling tool, PolOpT, which combines a multicriteria decision‐making technique and a recursive‐dynamic computable general equilibrium model. We applied it with datasets for six sub‐Saharan African countries, including hundreds of estimated parameters that transmit the effect of policy measures onto agricultural productivity. The approach demonstrates that reallocating agricultural public expenditure across policy measures in these countries can potentially boost agri‐food output by several percentage points, create almost a million off‐farm jobs in rural areas, lift almost 3 million people out of poverty and allow 16 million people more to afford a healthy diet—all without extra funding.
abstract_zh: 将农业公共资源重新配置到更高回报的激励措施和投资领域，有助于推动农业食品体系转型。这对低收入国家尤为重要，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这些国家有限的预算制约了农业支出增长的选择空间。我们证明，在预算约束范围内，仍存在实现更优农业转型成果的机遇。为此，我们开发了政策优化建模工具PolOpT，该工具融合了多准则决策技术与递归动态可计算一般均衡模型。我们利用六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数据集（包含数百个反映政策措施对农业生产率传导效应的估计参数）进行了应用分析。研究结果表明，在这些国家间重新配置农业公共支出，可在不增加额外资金的情况下，使农业食品产出提升数个百分点，在农村地区创造近百万非农就业岗位，帮助近300万人摆脱贫困，并使1600万人能够负担健康膳食。

title: Market Integration and Nonlinear Price Transmission in 19th‐Century British Wheat Markets
title_zh: 19世纪英国小麦市场中的市场整合与非线性价格传导
title_primary: 19世纪英国小麦市场中的市场整合与非线性价格传导
title_secondary: Market Integration and Nonlinear Price Transmission in 19th‐Century British Wheat Markets
authors: Barry K. Goodwin, A. Ford Ramsey
official: 官方在线 2026-04-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Important developments in infrastructure and institutions characterized 19th‐Century wheat markets in Great Britain. Among these developments was the construction of the national rail system which enabled cheaper and more efficient transport of grain and other bulky cargoes between inland towns and ports. We consider the degree to which wheat markets in twelve British cities were spatially integrated over the nineteenth century by applying conventional threshold models and semi‐nonparametric (generalized additive) models of spatial price linkages. Although results concerning market integration are qualitatively similar, the semi‐nonparametric models capture important nonlinearities that may be missed by conventional threshold models. Both approaches support a high degree of integration among the spatially distinct markets. We then consider two sub‐samples from 1800–1840 and 1870–1913 to capture price transmission before and after the repeal of the Corn Laws, the development of the railway system, the improvement of steam engines for ocean transport, and the introduction of the telegraph system. The nonlinear models suggest faster equilibration in response to large shocks and tighter transaction cost bands in the second period.
abstract_zh: 摘要 19世纪英国小麦市场的发展以基础设施和制度的重大进步为特征。其中，全国铁路系统的建设使得谷物及其他大宗货物在内陆城镇与港口之间的运输更加廉价和高效。我们通过应用传统阈值模型和半非参数（广义可加）空间价格联动模型，考察了19世纪英国十二个城市小麦市场在空间上的整合程度。尽管关于市场整合的结果在性质上相似，但半非参数模型捕捉到了传统阈值模型可能遗漏的重要非线性特征。两种方法均支持这些空间上相互分离的市场具有高度整合性。随后，我们选取1800–1840年和1870–1913年两个子样本，以考察《谷物法》废除、铁路系统发展、远洋运输蒸汽机改进以及电报系统引入前后的价格传导情况。非线性模型表明，在第二个时期，市场对较大冲击的均衡调整速度更快，交易成本区间也更窄。

title: Information flows in trading networks
title_zh: 贸易网络中信息流动
title_primary: 贸易网络中信息流动
title_secondary: Information flows in trading networks
authors: Stefan J. Huber, Edward M. Watts, Christina Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the informational value of trading networks in over-the-counter (OTC) markets. Using detailed transaction-level data from the corporate bond market, we show that investors with larger dealer networks make superior trading decisions before changes in credit fundamentals, resulting in better risk-adjusted performance. We trace these investors’ superior trading decisions to trading connections where dealers are most likely to have access to novel credit-relevant information, supporting the interpretation that these investors obtain private information through their trading networks. Collectively, our evidence highlights the importance of trading relationships for investors’ private information acquisition.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了场外交易（OTC）市场中交易网络的信息价值。利用公司债券市场的详细交易级数据，我们表明，拥有更大交易商网络的投资者在信用基本面变化前能做出更优的交易决策，从而获得更好的风险调整后表现。我们将这些投资者的卓越交易决策追溯到那些交易商最可能获取新颖信用相关信息的交易联系上，支持了这些投资者通过其交易网络获取私人信息的解释。总体而言，我们的证据强调了交易关系对投资者私人信息获取的重要性。

title: Credit Easing versus Quantitative Easing: Evidence from Corporate and Government Bond Purchase Programs
title_zh: 信贷宽松与量化宽松：基于企业与政府债券购买计划的证据

title_secondary: Credit Easing versus Quantitative Easing: Evidence from Corporate and Government Bond Purchase Programs
authors: STEFANIA D'AMICO, IRYNA KAMINSKA

abstract: Using security‐level data, we analyze the effects of UK corporate bond purchases (or credit easing, CE) and government bond purchases (or quantitative easing, QE) on corporate bond prices and issuance. Thus, we estimate CE's stock effects and its additional contribution relative to QE. We find that CE is more effective than QE in reducing credit spreads, especially for higher rated bonds, and in stimulating corporate bond issuance, which responds quite rapidly to corporate bond purchases. While QE pass‐through to corporate bond prices is significant and larger in the longer run than at announcement, it is often limited to the default‐free component of the corporate yield.
abstract_zh: 利用证券级数据，我们分析了英国公司债券购买（或信贷宽松，CE）与政府债券购买（或量化宽松，QE）对公司债券价格及发行的影响。据此，我们估算了CE的存量效应及其相对于QE的额外贡献。研究发现，在降低信用利差方面，CE比QE更为有效，尤其对高评级债券而言，并且在刺激公司债券发行方面，其反应相当迅速。尽管QE向公司债券价格的传导显著，且在长期内比公告时更大，但这种传导往往局限于公司收益率的无违约部分。

source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

abstract: Using model-free skewness measures that exploit the asymmetry in semivariances and option data from the over-the-counter currency market, we find that buying currencies with a high skewness risk premium (SRP) and selling currencies with a low SRP generates high returns and a Sharpe ratio. Asset pricing tests—which control for omitted variables and measurement errors—show that a SRP factor enters the currency pricing kernel and is central to the pricing of risks inherent in a broad currency cross section of 60 portfolio excess returns. These results imply that skewness risk is a strong and priced source of currency risk.
abstract_zh: 利用无模型偏度度量方法，该方法利用半方差的不对称性及场外货币市场期权数据，我们发现买入高偏度风险溢价（SRP）的货币并卖出低SRP的货币能产生高回报及夏普比率。资产定价测试——在控制遗漏变量和测量误差后——表明SRP因子进入货币定价核心，并对广泛货币截面中60个投资组合超额收益所固有的风险定价至关重要。这些结果意味着偏度风险是货币风险的一个强有力且被定价的来源。

abstract: This research evaluates the effectiveness of machine learning models by comparing the performance of seven models in predicting the return movement of four asset types over different return periods. The assets include S&P 500 Futures, Gold Futures, US 10Y Treasury Bond Futures, and a risk-free investment. The study considers 1-week, 4-week, and 12-week forward return periods. The analysis assesses model accuracy and portfolio performance using data spanning two decades. ML-based portfolios modestly outperform an equal-weighted benchmark in terms of risk-adjusted metrics over longer horizons, even though the differences are generally insignificant. However, the study emphasizes the importance of considering diverse economic cycles to understand asset behaviour comprehensively. Nevertheless, the study did not find significant evidence that combining machine learning prediction with dynamic asset allocation can outperform passive portfolio investment. The study underscores the potential of non-linear models in short-term trading but also notes limitations in adaptiveness, threshold design, and model generalization under atypical conditions. abstract_zh: 本研究通过比较七种机器学习模型在预测四种资产类别在不同回报周期下收益方向的有效性，评估了模型性能。资产类别包括标普500期货、黄金期货、美国10年期国债期货及无风险投资。研究考虑了1周、4周和12周的前瞻回报周期，并利用跨越二十年的数据对模型准确性和投资组合表现进行了分析。基于机器学习的投资组合在较长周期内，其风险调整指标略优于等权重基准，尽管差异通常不显著。然而，研究强调了考虑多样化经济周期以全面理解资产行为的重要性。尽管如此，研究并未发现显著证据表明将机器学习预测与动态资产配置相结合能够超越被动投资组合策略。研究揭示了非线性模型在短期交易中的潜力，但也指出了其在非典型条件下的适应性不足、阈值设计局限及模型泛化能力受限等问题。关键词：分类机器学习模型选择 技术分析 资产配置 交易算法 JEL分类：C38 C52 C61 G11 G17
